blocks.text:
In the morning, transfer from your hotel to the railway station.

Take a tourist train to Machu Picchu. The journey takes you through Peru’s mountain scenery to one of South America’s best-known archaeological sites.

Machu Picchu remained tucked away in the mountains for centuries, until an American researcher brought it to the attention of modern scholars in the 20th century. The inhabitants of this Inca city left for reasons that remain unknown.

On the guided tour, you’ll see stone buildings, terraces, narrow passages and the mountain slopes that surround the site.

After the guided tour, you’ll have free time to take photos, walk around the site and watch for llamas near the paths.

After visiting Machu Picchu, take the bus down to the village for lunch at **El MAPI** restaurant.

Then head back to the station for the return train and transfer to your hotel in Cusco.
Panoramic view of Cusco’s main square, a church and tiled roofs in Peru
Cusco: a bird’s-eye view of the square, church towers and red roofs

Breakfast. Today you’ll explore the Sacred Valley of the Incas.

The valley’s fertile soils and mild climate made it an important farming region. The ruins of ancient towns and farming complexes survive here.

You’ll visit **Urubamba**, associated with the country residence of the Inca ruler Huayna Capac.

At **Pisac**, the archaeological complex stands on Vilcabamba Hill. Nearby, you can visit a market and buy silverwork, ceramics and leather goods from local artisans.

The next stop is **Ollantaytambo**, with its ceremonial centre and preserved Inca town layout.

In **Chinchero**, you’ll see a colonial church built over the walls of the Inca Temple of the Sun.

At **Moray**, you’ll see agricultural terraces laid out in the shape of an amphitheatre.

At the **Awanakancha** centre, you can see llamas, alpacas and vicuñas and learn how they are cared for and how wool is traditionally dyed.

Enjoy a buffet lunch featuring Peruvian cuisine at **Inka House** restaurant.

Return to your hotel after the tour.
